_how_to_edit: This file IS the deck. Edit it and run:  python3 docs/slides/make_slides.py
figure : 'docs:name.png' looks in docs/figures, 'paper:name.png' in paper/figures/out.
title  : the heading beside the figure. Keep it under about 30 characters.
bullets: 2-4 very short lines. They are printed as a bulleted list.
caveat : one line, printed in amber under the bullets. Leave '' for none.
Reorder, delete or add entries freely. A figure that does not exist stops the build
rather than producing a slide with a hole in it.

slides.title: What each stage does
bullets: The pipeline the app runs, panel by panel.
Seven flattening radii, unioned.
Every candidate region kept.
slides.caveat: The retired classifier would have deleted 21.6% of this.

slides.title: Every method, identical data
bullets: 11 arms, same 15 tiles, same budget.
The ranking REVERSES between the two metrics.
slides.caveat: Dashed line = a correct 3 px trace. Above it means fatter, not better.

slides.figure: paper:6 - SEM, what deleting the region classifier recovers.png
slides.title: What deleting the classifier recovers
bullets: Three specimens went from recall 0.000 to 0.35-0.68.
The cracks were always found; the model rejected them.
slides.caveat: It costs precision on clean fields: 0.89 to 0.78.

slides.title: How you report it matters more than the method
bullets: One set of masks, six ways of reporting it.
IoU spans 0.1985 across them.
slides.caveat: That span is larger than any method change measured here.

slides.title: A correct answer caps at IoU 0.50
bullets: A perfectly placed trace peaks at 0.4993.
So IoU 0.42 is ~75% of possible, not 42%.
slides.caveat: Always quote IoU with this ceiling.

slides.title: The metrics reward thickness
bullets: Dilating the mask adds no information.
It still moves clDice +0.048 on 13 of 13.
Skeleton-F1 moves +0.0015.
slides.caveat: IoU, clDice and the paint gate all have this fault.

slides.title: On public datasets
bullets: Frozen: 0.631 on DeepCrack, 0.087 on CrackForest.
Refitting one constant: 0.793 and 0.450.
slides.caveat: CrackForest's fitted value reaches 95% of refitting on DeepCrack.

slides.title: Against six classical baselines
bullets: 1st of 7 on DeepCrack (0.821 vs 0.730).
3rd of 7 on CrackForest, behind two ridge filters.
slides.caveat: Better on wide bright cracks, worse on thin faint ones. Panels are 118 and 120 images -- don't read across.

slides.title: The same, on the images
bullets: Ground truth, frozen, and refitted.
One typical image per dataset.
slides.caveat: Images picked by rule (nearest the mean), not by eye.

slides.title: Recall alone is not a score
bullets: The loosest setting reaches recall 0.98.
Its F1 is 0.162 and its precision equals plain Otsu.
slides.caveat: Read precision against the floor: 0.081 on TXM, 0.030 on your tiles.
